title: The Best Sony Lenses For Photo & Video
summary: If you're a hybrid creator looking to expand your arsenal of lenses – you can't go wrong with these 12 solid options.
body_markdown:
If you're a hybrid creator with a day that swings from hero stills to buttery slow‑mo, you need glass that can keep up. For hybrid shooting, you want lenses that can nail tack‑sharp photos, pull smooth focus without breathing, and play nice with fast AF and great color. Sony’s got a few that punch way above their weight on both fronts. Here are 12 lenses that pull real double duty for photo and video:


#### [28-70mm f/2 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel2870gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article)


##### Why It’s Great for Hybrid Creators:


If you want extra speed without giving up range, the[28-70mm f/2 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel2870gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) delivers a constant f/2 across a workhorse zoom. It’s the perfect all-in-one for run‑and‑gun doc work, events, portraits and b‑roll – letting you keep ISO lower, shutter cleaner and backgrounds nicely separated in both photo and video. The fast aperture also helps maintain consistent exposure and depth of field when you punch in mid‑take, which hybrid shooters appreciate.


[Click here to purchase the 28-70mm f/2 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel2870gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) .


#### [50-150mm f/2 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel50150gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article)


##### Why It’s Great for Hybrid Creators:


Bridging portrait to action, the[50-150mm f/2 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel50150gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) gives you a bright, constant f/2 through a highly usable mid‑tele range. It’s perfect for interviews, compressed cityscapes, stage work and indoor sports where you need speed, reach and creamy separation. For video, the consistent aperture helps nail exposure continuity while the range lets you reframe quickly without swapping lenses—great for fast-paced shoots.

The[12-24mm f/2.8 G Master](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel1224gm?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) provides creators with that ultra-wide angle that’s ideal for expansive landscapes, architecture, and creative wide-angle shots in video. Its constant f/2.8 aperture ensures consistent brightness and depth of field control throughout the zoom range, so you know you’ll be covered. And it’s a G Master, so you know you’re guaranteed outstanding resolution and minimal distortion, crucial for wide-angle photography and videography.

Hybrid creators need versatility, and the[16-35mm f/2.8 G Master II](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/lenses/all-e-mount/p/sel1635gm2?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) is an excellent wide angle option for things like landscape photography, architecture and vlogging where a wider perspective is needed. Its constant f/2.8 aperture maintains high performance in low light and provides consistent depth of field, which all video shooters know is important. The second-generation G Master provides edge-to-edge sharpness and minimizes distortion, which is vital for both photo and video.

You want details? This lens delivers them with exceptional resolution. Its G Master optical design delivers sharp detail, while macro-tuned Optical SteadyShot helps compensate for angle, shift and depth shake during handheld close-up shooting. With up to 1.4x magnification, fast, precise and quiet autofocus driven by four XD linear motors, and an 11-blade aperture for smooth bokeh, it gives hybrid creators the control and image quality needed for high-impact macro work.
